# Version 3.116.0
> **Stable SkiaSharp 3 release** · Released December 2, 2024 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/3.116.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v3.116.0)

> **Supersedes [3.0.0](3.0.0.md)** · Rolls up preview-only work that was never released as stable — those changes are included cumulatively below.

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](3.116.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/8.3.0/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 3.116.0 stabilizes the 3.0 platform refresh with .NET 9 and WebAssembly support. It adds span-friendly drawing APIs and addresses Blazor hosting and platform graphics issues. Review the 3.0 migration changes before upgrading from 2.x.

## Breaking Changes

- **Legacy obsolete APIs were removed** — Members that were previously marked obsolete are no longer available. Update callers to the replacement APIs before moving from SkiaSharp 2.x. ([#2539](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/2539))

## Platform

- **WebAssembly and Blazor support updated** — Fixes applications hosted below a base path, improves .NET 9 Blazor compatibility, and adds multi-threaded and SIMD WebAssembly support. ([#3093](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3093), [#3089](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3089), [#3081](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3081), [#3087](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3087), [#2620](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/2620))

## API Surface

- **Span-based point and path overloads added** — SKMatrix mapping and SKPath.AddPoly can now consume spans of points without requiring array allocations. — ❤️ [@alexandrvslv](https://github.com/alexandrvslv) ([#3030](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3030))

## HarfBuzzSharp 8.3.0

Carries the bundled HarfBuzz update and the associated WebAssembly and interop improvements into the stable 3.116 release.
